title: Charred Paneer Gratin
description: A creamy, cheesy Indian-inspired dish featuring pan-seared paneer, topped with a rich gratin.
instructions: In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon butter over medium heat. Add the sliced onion and cook until caramelized, about 8-10 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Stir in the flour and cook for 1-2 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add the shredded cheese and stir until melted and smooth.
Add the charred paneer to the skillet and stir to coat with the cheese sauce.
Transfer the paneer mixture to a baking dish and top with additional cheese.
Dot the top with the remaining 1 tablespoon butter.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, until golden brown and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
